mattpocock.reason: The release tag v1.3.2. "Plugin 1.3.1" names two commits: the v1.3.1 tag (24fe0ef) and the commit installed as 1.3.1 from the official marketplace (49dd158), which serves main without bumping the version, and their grilling differ. A release tag names exactly one commit. v1.3.2 is the first one after the installed 1.3.1; its only change to grilling asks for sub-agents with a fresh context window. Commits after v1.3.2 are unreleased.
